caption:
Basic Masala Omelette 

Nutrition: 
C: 14 | F: 12 | P: 16
Calories: 248 per serve ( without bread ) 
Makes 2 Omelettes

Ingredients
knobb of butter 
4 eggs
1 tbsp milk
1 onion, finely chopped
1 tomato, finely chopped
2 - 3 green chillies, finely chopped 
salt + pepper to taste 

Method 
combine all the ingredients mentioned in a bowl and mix together 
add butter to the pan 
add the mix to the pan and allow to cook then flip it over
fold it over 
serve with some buttered toast or enjoy as is :)
